title: Into My Arms: Structured reinforcement learning for autonomous transport of objects and humans
abstract: arXiv:2611.29771v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Whole-body humanoid manipulation remains bottlenecked by high-dimensional state-action spaces, contact-rich environments, and long task horizons. This trilemma is a challenge that state-of-the-art reinforcement learning (RL) methods are yet to resolve reliably. We address it with three contributions that add just enough structure to guide exploration: Sparse Interaction Edges (SIE) for whole-body manipulation, Interaction Gated Transport (IGT) for sustained transport over long horizons, and a Hinted Object Path (HOP) that resolves collision and search complexity bottlenecks. Across all three, the policy remains free to discover its own manipulation strategy. The method generalises from rigid object to human transport. As a flagship demonstration, we show, to our knowledge, the first bed-to-wheelchair transfer of a medical mannequin by a humanoid robot completed with no human intervention during execution. translated_title: 入我怀中：用于自主搬运物体与人类的结构化强化学习
translated_abstract: 全身人形机器人操作一直受限于高维状态-动作空间、接触密集的环境以及长任务时域这三重难题，这是目前最先进的强化学习方法尚未能可靠解决的挑战。我们通过三项贡献来应对这一难题，这三项贡献为探索过程添加了恰到好处的结构引导：用于全身操作的稀疏交互边，用于长时域持续搬运的交互门控搬运，以及用于化解碰撞与搜索复杂性瓶颈的提示物体路径。在所有这三项设计中，策略始终保持自由，可以自主发现自己的操作策略。该方法能够从刚体物体搬运推广至人体搬运。作为旗舰演示，据我们所知，我们展示了首例由人形机器人在执行过程中无需任何人工干预完成的医疗人体模型从床到轮椅的转移。在人体搬运领域
tldr: 该论文提出三项结构化强化学习技术（稀疏交互边SIE、交互门控搬运IGT和提示物体路径HOP），在保留策略自主探索自由度的同时引导全身人形机器人操作，并首次实现了人形机器人无人工干预地将医疗人体模型从病床转移到轮椅。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces three structured reinforcement learning techniques—Sparse Interaction Edges (SIE), Interaction Gated Transport (IGT), and Hinted Object Path (HOP)—that add just enough structure to guide exploration in whole-body humanoid manipulation while keeping the policy free to discover its own strategies, and demonstrates the first autonomous bed-to-wheelchair transfer of a medical mannequin by a humanoid robot with no human intervention during execution.
